# UpdateGamma <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
UpdateGamma:Void calibrate:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `calibrate` | In | Int32 | `0` | 1 to use the calibration of the display. Defaults to 0. |

## Description

Makes the gamma tables that [SetGamma](SetGamma) changed count: the window is shown through them from now on, also if the program only draws to the front buffer and does not [Flip](Flip).

## Differences

* The original gave the tables to the display. This only changes the window, never the gamma of the display, so nothing outside of the program looks different. `calibrate` has no effect, as no calibration of the display is used.
